scope: 96 safe extracted source paths listed in knowledge/libraries/rtec-compliance/sources/extracted-safe-source-catalog.md
method: For every SHA-256 in the extracted-safe-source catalog, searched the repository and required at least one occurrence outside archive-corpus, sanitized/extracted catalogs, archive summary, and exact-duplicate inventory.
conclusion: All safe sources that were successfully extracted into the 52-chunk text corpus have at least one modeled/canonical repository representation. Remaining ingestion work is concentrated in safe scan-only/non-text assets, grant-binder pages, remaining version/authority reconciliation, and explicit disposition of sources that cannot add reusable knowledge.
privacy_note: This audit covers safe sources only. Restricted sources remain metadata/aggregate only and were not opened for generalized content promotion.
